gaps.valueSet: Blood specimen constraints for Babesiosis microscopy
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no specimen-type evidence or predicate and the source HL7 Blood value set has no codes; general-specimen test branches in source rules 2 and 9 are omitted while their blood-specific test-name alternatives remain modeled

source rules 4-6 are explicitly not implemented because titer results cannot be evaluated; SEM_V1 also has no titer comparison for B. microti or B. divergens >= 1:256 or B. duncani >= 1:512, so the rules are omitted
